card.name: Night and daytime after at/during
card.fires_on: The word night, day, or life that ends a time-of-day or daily-routine phrase, usually right after "at", "during the" or "in daily". It appears in both drug labels and general web text.

modes.label: At night
modes.description: The word night after "at" when saying when something is done or happens.
modes.example: Apply a thin film of BLEMISH ERASER to the affected area once daily at<< night>> or as directed by a doctor.

modes.label: Daytime or daily-life phrases
modes.description: Day or life after "during the" or "in daily", naming a period or routine.
modes.example: Patients may use moisturizers and/or cosmetics during the<< day>>.
